summary: Recorded the tie-break probe's receipt as an unresolved account instead of a finding, because the measurement and the mechanism do not yet line up. Both declared comparisons are violated - with the empty reply delivered last and with it delivered first, the owner's own recovery of its own instance left the instance holding no command and emitted no proposal - so the provisional hypothesis that the adopted value depends on arrival order among same-ballot replies is refuted by the order-independent outcome. The account states what the receipt measures (owner at status ACCEPTED with X before the recovery at index 0, then status PREACCEPTED with an empty command list and bookkeeping at lb_appended 1, lb_nacks 0, lb_cmds_len 0, lb_last_tried_ballot 0, lb_ballot -1 at index 4, no proposal and no command after at index 5, and the same values for the second order at indices 10-11) and what is not yet explained: that bookkeeping is inconsistent with my reading of both startRecoveryForInstance's self reply and handlePrepareReply's append-or-nack branch, and it is the same status-with-empty-command combination that the recorded status/command invariant rules out. A necessary gap now records that question with the planned discriminator - a re-run recording instance pointer identity, status and command length plus leader-bookkeeping fields after each individual reply delivery - so the next step is to separate a target path I have not traced from a construction error in this probe. No defect is claimed for the scenario; the five previously explained questions, the three asserted defects, the holds account and the eight knowledge entries are unchanged.
